rows.notes: x6, shared across scenes; generic 'why' reply.

rows.en:
Looked like you'd dropped your wallet,
so I figured I'd give it back.

I thought so.
I was going to hand it over once you noticed.
rows.notes: kidzuitara: 'once you noticed' kept open (noticed him, or noticed the loss).

rows.en: I had no idea I'd dropped it...
Don't lose it again. See you.
Wait, let me thank you properly!
rows.notes: orei wo: the player offers a thank-you/reward.
The player is about to ask his name.
Female version of 'just my imagination' choice branch.
Female version of the tackle shout.
Answers 'Are you all right?'; whiny elongation kept.

rows.en:
...Um, you've been following me around,
haven't you...

rows.notes: Female version; same English as c00296.

rows.en:
(Maybe I'll take a little walk
before heading home...)

He's gone...
That was Brera-san, wasn't it?

I never thanked him properly the other day.
Maybe I'll catch up and talk to him.

H-he's so fast...
I can't catch up at all...
The way he moves... He's no ordinary guy...
Ah, I'm about to lose him!
...You're... the one from the other day...

(He was walking in front of me...
When did he get behind me...?)
rows.notes: Trailing 'itsu no ma ni' completed with the sense of the scene (he appeared behind the player, c00334).

rows.en:
N-no... It's nothing that important.
I just saw you in town and thought I'd
say hello, that's all...
Then you should've just called out to me.
You walk way too fast, Brera-san...

You scared me, calling out from behind
me all of a sudden.

And you did well to keep up with me
without getting shaken off. Impressive.
rows.notes: omae koso: turns it back on the player.

rows.en:
But I don't approve of tailing people...
There won't be a next time. Understood?

Nah, better not.
I'd probably just be bothering him...
(Okay, I'll do some shopping and head home.)

(Hmm, going straight home like this
feels kind of lonely...)

(I know, I'll stop by
Griffith Park today.)
What are you doing in a place like this?
Are you good at playing it?
You should head home soon too.
(Maybe he's just not good with words?)

(Hmm, going straight home like this
is kind of lonely, isn't it...)
